identification: Three cardboard boxes of used HO-scale (labelled 'H0/00') American-outline model railway items. Box 1: a divided tray of 15 heavily hand-weathered 40ft freight cars, Athearn 'blue box' type kit-built plastic: New York Central 'Central' boxcars (2), Santa Fe boxcars incl. 'Shock Control' (3), Santa Fe and another caboose (2), Pacific Fruit Express UP reefers (3, orange), stock cars (2), outside-braced boxcars and a green boxcar. Boxes 2-3: about 30 assembled plastic kit buildings (European Faller/Kibri/Vollmer-type houses and terraces, US-style frame houses, water tower, coaling tower, small station, sheds, a tunnel/rock piece), dusty, a few with loose parts.

entries.note: Snippet only from local database (page not opened). 4 boxes HO/OO buildings (Faller/Vollmer style), track, scenery, trees, accessories. Buildings and layout items only, no rolling stock, so a partial comparison. AUD, no conversion.
